scope: The eight-direction signal-group convention documented by T-DATA only. This does not assign any physical crossing to a group or map UTIC ring channels.

evidence.method: Read the official direction-code diagram and pedestrian-group convention, then match the documented API output field labels. No route geometry or nearest-light heuristic is used.

documentedExample.note: The API direction label describes the associated incoming vehicle approach, not the side on which the crossing lies. This example is not a mapping for intersection 2207.

remainingTimeConversion.reason: The portal labels RmdrCs as centiseconds but its value description says 1/10 second. The PDF repeats the centisecond label. A measured sample or provider clarification is still needed.

limitations: A crossing management ID, stage and applicable lane/connection must be verified before choosing one entry.
An arbitrary MAP group or another provider's channel number is not assumed to use this convention.
The codebook is not an operating plan, a current-state observation or a verified prediction input.
